dimensions.assessment: Affects state child welfare agencies, foster and adoptive families, kinship placement providers, and children in or entering the foster care system.
dimensions.evidence: foster and adoptive parent recruitment and retention

dimensions.assessment: Requires states to implement comprehensive family partnership plans and collect detailed demographic and capacity data annually.
dimensions.evidence: development and implementation of a family partnership plan... for identification, recruitment, screening, licensing, support, and retention

dimensions.assessment: The source does not provide specific figures on federal spending alterations or funding allocations for state data collection.
Amends parts B and E of title IV of the Social Security Act by imposing new state plan requirements and mandates additions to the annual child welfare report to Congress.
dimensions.evidence: amend parts B and E of title IV of the Social Security Act

dimensions.assessment: Establishes permanent federal reporting requirements and ongoing state plan mandates effective starting October 2027.

missing_information: Financial cost to state governments to implement the new data collection and family partnership plans.
Whether federal grants will offset state administrative expenses.
